guardians.label: Guardians
guardians.title: People you trust. For the moment nobody plans.
guardians.lead: "When I'm gone" messages don't follow a date. They follow a long silence from you. Guardians make sure nothing goes out by mistake.
steps: You set how many days without any activity in ARCA before it reaches out (90 by default).
When that time passes, we email your guardians two links: "They're fine" and "Release the messages". The links are valid for 72 hours.
One guardian confirming you're fine is enough, and the countdown starts over.
If nobody responds, the messages are delivered after a grace period you choose.
guardians.noGuardians: Guardians are optional. Without them, we email you directly, and you can cancel the delivery during the grace period.
guardians.privacy: Guardians never see what your messages say. They only know their titles.

security.label: Security and trust
security.title: Plainly, without hype.
security.lead: You're trusting us with something personal. So here's exactly how it works, including what we don't do (yet).

points.title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
points.body: Connections are encrypted (HTTPS), and data is stored with our infrastructure provider, encrypted at the storage level.

points.title: An extra layer for the Life Manual
points.body: The most sensitive details (passwords, account access, instructions) get an extra layer of encryption with our own key (AES-256-GCM).

points.title: Not end-to-end
points.body: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. We say it upfront, so you can decide what goes into them.

points.title: Opens only after delivery
points.body: The recipient opens the message through a personal link, only after it's delivered. You can add a security question only they can answer.

points.title: Your own copy
points.body: Download your messages as a PDF at any time (text and recording transcripts).

points.title: AI only when you ask
points.body: If you use the AI helper, the text is processed by an external AI provider. Nothing is sent unless you click.

whatIf.q: …I go quiet for a long time?
whatIf.a: "When I'm gone" messages go through your guardians first. If you have none, we email you. Messages with a fixed date wait for their day; a long silence won't send them early.
Until delivery, you can edit a message at any time, including its date and recipients.
During the grace period, you can cancel delivery in one click. Guardians stop it by confirming you're fine.

items.a: No. You can write for a birthday, an anniversary, yourself in ten years, or any day you choose. Messages for when you're gone are just one of the options.

items.q: How do guardians know it's time to deliver?
items.a: They don't decide on their own. When you go quiet for a long time, ARCA emails them two links: "They're fine" and "Release the messages". If nobody responds, the messages are delivered after a grace period.

items.q: Can I edit or cancel a message?
items.a: Until delivery, you can edit it at any time, including its date and recipients. If a message enters its grace period after a long silence from you, you can cancel the delivery.
An email with a personal link. They open the message through it, after answering a security question if you set one. They don't need an ARCA account.
